gloss: to turn on; to attach; to wear; to name; to season

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: つけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to turn on, to switch on
definitions.explanation: To switch on a light or an electrical appliance (TV, air conditioner, radio, heater). Also written {点|つ}ける. The opposite is {消|け}す, and the intransitive is つく: {電気|でんき}がつく (the light comes on).

To light or set fire to something: a fire, a candle, a gas burner, a cigarette. Usually {火|ひ}をつける, also written {点|つ}ける or {付|つ}ける. Figuratively, {火|ひ}をつける can mean to spark off a dispute or someone's enthusiasm.

definitions.gloss: to attach, to fix; to apply
definitions.explanation: To attach or fix one thing to another (a button on a shirt, a collar on a dog, a basket on a bicycle), or to apply something to a surface (ointment on a cut, butter on bread). Pattern: YにXをつける. Written {付|つ}ける in kanji.

definitions.gloss: to wear, to put on (a mask, a ring)
definitions.explanation: To put on or wear an item fastened to the body rather than a garment: a mask, a ring, a necklace, an apron. Written {着|つ}ける in kanji. Clothes take {着|き}る, trousers and shoes はく, hats かぶる.

definitions.gloss: to give (a name, a mark, a price)
definitions.explanation: To give or assign something to someone or something: a name ({名前|なまえ}をつける), a mark or score ({点|てん}をつける), a price ({値段|ねだん}をつける), or a condition attached to an agreement ({条件|じょうけん}をつける).
To keep a regular written record: a diary ({日記|にっき}をつける), household accounts ({家計簿|かけいぼ}をつける), a log of one's weight or spending. Written {付|つ}ける in kanji.
To give food a flavor: {味|あじ}をつける (season), {塩|しお}で{味|あじ}をつける (season with salt), {下味|したあじ}をつける (season in advance, before cooking).
Of a plant, to bear or put out flowers, buds or fruit: {花|はな}をつける, {実|み}をつける, つぼみをつける. Somewhat written in tone; in conversation {花|はな}が{咲|さ}く and {実|み}がなる are more usual.

definitions.gloss: to be careful ({気|き}をつける)
definitions.explanation: In the set phrase {気|き}をつける, to be careful or pay attention. What one watches out for takes に: {車|くるま}に{気|き}をつける. {気|き}をつけて (take care) is a common parting phrase. The phrase also has its own entry.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (intransitive): ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける → ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく
- Opposite of 'turn on': ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧

WRITING:
Kana つける is normal for every sense and usual for switching things on. The kanji depend on the sense:
- {点|つ}ける: turn on, light
- ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: attach, give, keep a record, season, bear, be careful; see the separate entry ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧
- ⟦{着|つ}ける→着く：00680_tsuku⟧: wear, put on

A different verb shares the reading: ⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧ (to pickle, to soak), which has its own entry.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧／⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: turn on the light / TV
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: light a fire
